card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 57 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 6.8 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, V496 Aql: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 57.2 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 1,157 parsecs away.
